"""ISO 8601 durations.

A duration is ``P`` followed by date parts ``nY``, ``nM``, ``nW``, ``nD``
(in that order, each optional), then optionally ``T`` followed by time parts
``nH``, ``nM``, ``nS`` (in that order, each optional). Each ``n`` is a
non-negative integer, except that seconds may have a decimal fraction
(``PT1.5S``). At least one part must be present, and ``T`` must be followed
by at least one time part, so ``P``, ``PT``, ``P1H``, ``1D``, ``PT1.5M`` and
``P1D2Y`` are invalid. Parsing is case-sensitive; invalid input raises
``ValueError``.

``format`` writes the canonical form: parts in the order above, parts that
are zero left out, ``T`` only when a time part is present, and seconds
without a fraction when they are whole (``PT1S``, ``PT1.5S``). The zero
duration is ``PT0S``.

``add`` adds a duration to a datetime: first years and months, keeping the
day of the month but clamping it to the last day of the resulting month
(Jan 31 plus one month is Feb 28, or 29 in a leap year), then weeks, days,
hours, minutes, and seconds as exact elapsed time.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import calendar
import math
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from decimal import Decimal


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Duration:
    years: int = 0
    months: int = 0
    weeks: int = 0
    days: int = 0
    hours: int = 0
    minutes: int = 0
    seconds: float = 0


_PATTERN = re.compile(
    r"P"
    r"(?:(?P<years>[0-9]+)Y)?"
    r"(?:(?P<months>[0-9]+)M)?"
    r"(?:(?P<weeks>[0-9]+)W)?"
    r"(?:(?P<days>[0-9]+)D)?"
    r"(?:T"
    r"(?:(?P<hours>[0-9]+)H)?"
    r"(?:(?P<minutes>[0-9]+)M)?"
    r"(?:(?P<seconds>[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)S)?"
    r")?"
)

_DATE_PARTS = ("years", "months", "weeks", "days")
_TIME_PARTS = ("hours", "minutes", "seconds")


def _invalid(text: str) -> ValueError:
    """Build the error raised for an invalid duration string."""
    return ValueError(f"invalid ISO 8601 duration: {text!r}")


def _format_seconds(seconds: float) -> str:
    """Render non-negative seconds without a needless decimal fraction."""
    text = format(Decimal(repr(float(seconds))), "f")
    if "." in text:
        text = text.rstrip("0").rstrip(".")
    return text


def parse(text: str) -> Duration:
    """Parse an ISO 8601 duration."""
    match = _PATTERN.fullmatch(text)
    if match is None:
        raise _invalid(text)

    values = match.groupdict()
    has_date = any(values[name] is not None for name in _DATE_PARTS)
    has_time = any(values[name] is not None for name in _TIME_PARTS)

    # ``P``, ``PT``, and values such as ``P1DT`` have no actual part.
    if not has_date and not has_time:
        raise _invalid(text)
    # The ``T`` separator must introduce at least one time part.
    if "T" in text and not has_time:
        raise _invalid(text)

    seconds = float(values["seconds"]) if values["seconds"] is not None else 0.0
    return Duration(
        years=int(values["years"] or 0),
        months=int(values["months"] or 0),
        weeks=int(values["weeks"] or 0),
        days=int(values["days"] or 0),
        hours=int(values["hours"] or 0),
        minutes=int(values["minutes"] or 0),
        seconds=seconds,
    )


def format(duration: Duration) -> str:
    """Write ``duration`` in canonical ISO 8601 form."""
    values = (
        duration.years,
        duration.months,
        duration.weeks,
        duration.days,
        duration.hours,
        duration.minutes,
        duration.seconds,
    )
    if any(value < 0 for value in values):
        raise ValueError("cannot format a negative duration")
    if not math.isfinite(duration.seconds):
        raise ValueError("cannot format a non-finite duration")

    parts = ["P"]
    if duration.years:
        parts.append(f"{duration.years}Y")
    if duration.months:
        parts.append(f"{duration.months}M")
    if duration.weeks:
        parts.append(f"{duration.weeks}W")
    if duration.days:
        parts.append(f"{duration.days}D")
    if duration.hours or duration.minutes or duration.seconds:
        parts.append("T")
        if duration.hours:
            parts.append(f"{duration.hours}H")
        if duration.minutes:
            parts.append(f"{duration.minutes}M")
        if duration.seconds:
            parts.append(f"{_format_seconds(duration.seconds)}S")

    if len(parts) == 1:
        return "PT0S"
    return "".join(parts)


def add(moment: datetime, duration: Duration) -> datetime:
    """``moment`` plus ``duration``."""
    total_months = moment.month - 1 + duration.years * 12 + duration.months
    year = moment.year + total_months // 12
    month = total_months % 12 + 1
    day = min(moment.day, calendar.monthrange(year, month)[1])

    adjusted = moment.replace(year=year, month=month, day=day)
    return adjusted + timedelta(
        weeks=duration.weeks,
        days=duration.days,
        hours=duration.hours,
        minutes=duration.minutes,
        seconds=duration.seconds,
    )
